We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work. Turning the Tide. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here. What You'll Do Your week will be a mix of keeping things running well and making them better. Operate and improve the platform. Monitoring, alerting, capacity, cost, and the steady stream of small improvements that keep a large AWS and Kubernetes estate healthy. Work in code, not consoles. Infrastructure changes go through Terraform and Helm, reviewed as pull requests and delivered through Atlantis and Argo CD. Keep the platform secure. Patching, vulnerability remediation, base image updates, and closing findings — a recurring, meaningful part of the job rather than a side task. Take part in incident response. You'll join our on-call rotation (SRE team, business hours) and contribute to incidents and follow-up work. Handle triage and requests from developer teams. Understanding what they need, unblocking them, and spotting when a repeated request could be automated. Who You Are We think you'll need Hands-on experience running workloads on AWS. Basic knowledge with Kubernetes. Basic knowledge about infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform. Comfortable with Git, Linux and Windows. Clear written communication — a lot of our work happens in tickets, PRs, and docs. Nice to have, not expected EKS specifically, or tooling like Karpenter, Argo CD, Atlantis, or Terramate. Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sumo Logic, or similar). Scripting in Python or Go. Security or compliance work — vulnerability management, CIS benchmarks, certification programmes. Multi-region or multi-account AWS architecture. What Matters More Than The Checklist You’re curious and self-driven, while also knowing when to ask for help when needed. You finish things. Small, well-tested changes shipped consistently beat big ideas that stall. You care about the developers and customers using the platform, not just the platform itself. On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement. An interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work — including MCP servers and agents against our own platform — and we expect that to grow. We don’t expect you to have experience with this—but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn. Don't meet every single requirement? No worries — this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. How You'll Grow Here We hire at this level expecting you to move beyond it, and we've structured the team so that happens on purpose rather than by accident. A rotation model that protects your focus. The team splits between operational duty and project work, so you're not permanently interrupt-driven. You get real blocks of time to go deep on something. Mentorship that's built in. Senior colleagues review your PRs and pair with you on incidents. Asking questions is the expected behaviour, not a sign you're struggling. Exposure to the big architecture work. You'll start with scoped pieces and take on more as you build context. A clear conversation about your development. Regular 1:1s that cover where you want to be, not just what you shipped last sprint. What We're Building Next Trackunit is moving from a SaaS company to a platform built on telemetry data from the construction industry worldwide. For SRE, that means going beyond delivering infrastructure to building the capabilities that let our developers and customers spin up environments tailored to their needs in the regions they need them. Things On Our Roadmap Include Expanding the platform into a true multi-region architecture. Building self-service platform capabilities so developer teams move at their own pace. Making better use of AI in our own operations, through MCP servers and agents. You won't be expected to lead these on day one. You will be in the room, and there will be pieces with your name on them. What Happens From Here — Recruitment Process Overview Virtual meet and greet. Meet with a member of our Talent Partner team Personality-based interview. You will be asked to complete an online personality assessment prior to the interview. There are no correct answers and we are not trying to categorise you — the aim is a dialogue about the results and Trackunit's culture, so you get to know us better as well. Assignment-specific interview. You will be given a case to prepare after the initial screening interview. You will present the case to relevant colleagues across Trackunit, who you will also work closely with in the role. Virtual meet and greet. Meet with Engineering Manager, Kåre Brandborg and an SRE team member. References and background checks (if needed). If required, we will obtain references from former employers and perform level-specific background checks, if you have not provided these yourself. Offer presentation and walk-through. We're lucky to have you! Coming Together To Connect Construction We're committed to construction — one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale. We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world. The question is: Are you in?
